name: (+/-)-8-hydroxy-2-(di-N-propylamino)tetralin
summary: 8-OH-DPAT, also known as 8-hydroxy-2-(dipropylamino)tetralin, is a serotonin 5-HT1A receptor agonist of the 2-aminotetralin family which was developed in the 1980s and has been widely used to study the function of the 5-HT1A receptor. It was one of the first major 5-HT1A receptor full agonists to have been discovered.

pharmacology.text: 8-OH-DPAT, also known as 8-hydroxy-2-(dipropylamino)tetralin, is a serotonin 5-HT1A receptor agonist of the 2-aminotetralin family which was developed in the 1980s and has been widely used to study the function of the 5-HT1A receptor. It was one of the first major 5-HT1A receptor full agonists to have been discovered.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT1A receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT7 receptor agonist; Serotonin reuptake inhibitor or releasing agent

uses.text: 8-OH-DPAT, also known as 8-hydroxy-2-(dipropylamino)tetralin, is a serotonin 5-HT1A receptor agonist of the 2-aminotetralin family which was developed in the 1980s and has been widely used to study the function of the 5-HT1A receptor.

summaryZh: 8-OH-DPAT，是1980年代開發的氨基四氫萘化學類研究化學品，常用於研究5-HT1A受體功能，是最早被發現的5-HT1A受體完全激動劑之一。
summaryZhHans: 8-OH-DPAT，是1980年代开发的氨基四氢萘化学类研究化学品，常用于研究5-HT1A受体功能，是最早被发现的5-HT1A受体完全激动剂之一。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is a laboratory tool rather than a drug people take. In animals it lowers body temperature and produces a characteristic set of serotonin-related behaviours.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它是實驗室工具，而不是供人使用的藥物。在動物身上，它會降低體溫並引發一組與血清素相關的特有行為。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它是实验室工具，而不是供人使用的药物。在动物身上，它会降低体温并引发一组与血清素相关的特有行为。

fact.en: Better known as 8-OH-DPAT, it was one of the first full switches found for the 5-HT1A receptor and is still a standard laboratory reference compound for it worldwide.
fact.zh: 它更常以8-OH-DPAT之名為人所知，是最早被發現能完全活化5-HT1A受體的化合物之一，至今仍是全球研究該受體的標準參考化合物。
fact.zhHans: 它更常以8-OH-DPAT之名为人所知，是最早被发现能完全活化5-HT1A受体的化合物之一，至今仍是全球研究该受体的标准参考化合物。
